sentences.text: In  WPA 24441 of 2014  CAN 2 of 2024  Bishnu Kumar Chettri & others  -vs-  Dr. Preeti Goyal  Mr. B. P. Subba  Ms. Nibedita Chakraborty  ...for the petitioners  Mr. Sirsanya Bandopadhyay  Ms. Tapati Samanta  ...for the State  Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State  respondents submits as follows.

At the time of passing of the order dated 27.06.2023, it was not pointed out by any of the parties that the order was principally to be carried out by the Land Acquisition Collector, Kalimpong instead of the Land Acquisition Collector, Darjeeling.
Although initially the matter was under the domain of the Land Acquisition Collector, but, at present, it is under the jurisdiction of the Land Acquisition Collector, Kalimpong.
In fact, the Land Acquisition Collector, Kalimpong was not even added as a respondent in the cause title.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that an application for contempt has already been filed for non-compliance of the order.
However, the petitioners would have no objection, if the order is modified to the extent that the Land Acquisition Collector, Kalimpong would go on carry out the order.
In view of the above, the order dated 27.06.2023 is modified to the following extent.

Let the Bishnu Kumar Chettri & Others vs Dr. Preeti Goyal on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94591022/
1 concerned respondents and the Land Acquisition Collector, Kalimpong take appropriate steps to initiate a fresh proceeding under the Act of 2013 for acquisition of land already taken over by the respondents BRO/GREF for construction of road and pay appropriate compensation to the petitioners in respect of the land taken over, within a period of four months from this date.

CAN 2 of 2024 is accordingly disposed of.
Urgent Photostat certified copy of this order be supplied to the parties, if applied for, as early as possible.
